Plan: PROTOCOL.mdBottom line: FINAL_REPORT.md. Two separate bases for 88 The measurements are compared to the general grid They're all in the same six states, algebra SEQ-10 unchanged.

From the root of the project in PowerShell:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

Integrity checks first. Completed stages and timeouts don't repeat. JOURNAL.jsonl The new budget requires a new attempt.

  • experiment.py, PROTOCOL.md, MANIFEST.json: Fixed data and limits.
  • joint_solver.py: generators, exact basis modulo n², LLL, separate method.
  • inputs/: everything 12 entrances created prior to the first scientific launch.
  • constructions/, lattices/: Initial constructions, bases and transformations.
  • algebra/, algebra_checkpoints/: Completed algebra and available transformations.
  • results/, progress/: Statuses, budgets, hashes and the last saved stage.
  • ARITHMETIC.json, audit.py, AUDIT.json: Independent certificates and inspections.
  • MEASUREMENTS.json, COMPARISON.json: All measurements and paired results.
  • RETRY_INDEX.json: only incomplete outcomes SEQ-12; historical index SEQ-11.
  • INTERRUPTION.json, interruptions/, continuation.py: ragged Attempt and continuation after an external interruption, its exact time unknown. limit 120 (c) Separately reserved in the initial budget.
  • REAL.json: Structural calculation, without finding the real keys.
  • PROVENANCE.json, PRIOR_SNAPSHOT.json, ENVIRONMENT.json: origin and integrity.
  • RESUME_CHECK.json, ACCEPTANCE.json, COMPLETE.json, ARTIFACTS.json: acceptance.

Interpretation: timeout Unknown outcome in the budget; no_certified_equations The method did not have sufficient stringent equations. unit_ideal Certificate of Contradiction to a Specific Entry/borders. Successful controls refer to synthetic classes with a general shift.

One computational CPU-process Python 3.11.9, python-flint 0.9.0 and SymPy 1.14.0. No GPU and installations. General scientific budget 1800 c. audit to 180 (c) Entrance separately.
